critical_issues: Injunctive relief available without proving damages
Must limit access to need-to-know personnel
strengths: Reasonable 2-year survival after termination (except trade secrets)
No obligation to proceed with business relationship
Can disclose if required by law with notice
rationale: This is a balanced, standard mutual NDA appropriate for preliminary discussions. Both parties have equal obligations, the term is reasonable (3 years with 2-year survival), and exclusions are fair. The indefinite trade secret protection is standard under law. No unusual or one-sided provisions.
